verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents an async parameter that submits a search and returns immediately, so results can be retrieved later instead of holding the HTTP connection open [serpapi-docs-9]. Those results are then fetched through the Searches Archive API [serpapi-docs-14], which covers the story's asynchronous-job path. Cached repeat searches are free for 1h, which helps high-volume workloads [serpapi-docs-13]. Missing for 10: a batch submission endpoint, documented throughput or rate limits for high-volume async workloads, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the async flow.
